thread:
Jin (oncall): heads-up: we just saw another egress TLS retry surge from ap-southeast. pattern looks like previous incident but smaller. raising as postmortem follow-up.
Maya (SRE): saw it too, graphs show spike at 06:12 UTC, ~18% tls_handshake_failures -> retries.
Sam (neteng): any sign of routing changes or config rollouts around that time?
Jin (oncall): no manual changes. deploy bot shows no canary or deploys.
Dev Deploy Bot: no deploys in last 3 hours for affected clusters.
Olivia (eng-runtime): extracting logs now. initial grep shows ALPN negotiation errors and intermittent SNI mismatch traces. sample: ```2026-11-03T06:12:17Z tls: handshake failed: remote error: tls: unsupported_extension (SNI mismatch) src=10.2.1.45 dst=34.76.12.9```
Priya (product): is this the recurring cross-region TLS problem we documented in the last postmortem? any overlap with customer-facing errors?
Maya (SRE): looks similar to PM-2026-04 (cross-region tls retries). root cause then was a routing table flap + slow cert rotation. this one shows SNI intermittency rather than cert expiry.
Sam (neteng): could be egress path going through an older edge that hasn't picked up the latest cert/shard. I'll check LB route stability and egress-pop mapping.
Olivia (eng-runtime): action items we should track: 1) triage whether it's routing or cert binding, 2) short-term mitigation (route pin / fallback to regional), 3) longer fix (ripcord for cert rollouts + probe).
Jin (oncall): assigning owners: Sam -> routing ownership, Maya -> telemetry/correlation, Olivia -> runtime fallback logic, Priya -> customer comms if it reaches threshold.
Sam (neteng): noted. ETA for initial routing dig: 2 hours. will post findings here.
Maya (SRE): I'll correlate retry bursts with route changes and cert rotation logs, ETA 3 hours. I'll also add an alert refinement to avoid noise.
Olivia (eng-runtime): I'll open a tiny PR to enable regional fallback for TLS handshake failures (config toggle) and a canary to validate. target EOD today for draft.
Priya (product): if any customer-facing hit, I can prepare a short status blurb. otherwise we'll wait for triage.
Jin (oncall): temporary mitigation: Sam, can you pin traffic away from suspect POPs for next 1 hour?
Sam (neteng): doing a soft-splay away from ap-southeast-pop-03. monitoring for improvement.
Dev Deploy Bot: route-splay command executed by Sam at 06:28 UTC.
Maya (SRE): after splay, retries dropped ~60% within 6 minutes. looks promising.
Olivia (eng-runtime): good signal. I'd still like to push fallback to reduce customer risk if this recurs.
Jin (oncall): recording action items in postmortem follow-ups doc. recurrent pattern detection: tag as "cross-region-tls-splay" and add to weekly incident review.
Maya (SRE): action items recap (owner - ETA): 1) routing deep-dive - Sam - 2h; 2) telemetry correlation + alert tuning - Maya - 3h; 3) runtime fallback PR - Olivia - EOD; 4) customer comms playbook check - Priya - 24h; 5) postmortem draft + recurrence analysis - Jin - 48h.
Sam (neteng): found an intermittent BGP export issue to ap-southeast-pop-03 causing some egress to route via stale edge. correlates with retry windows. working on a fix and a permanent rule to failover faster.
Priya (product): if we do a fallback to regional, we should measure latency delta; customers might see a small p99 increase, need to note in comms.
Olivia (eng-runtime): noted, I'll include telemetry to tag requests that used fallback so we can measure impact.
Jin (oncall): ok owners + ETAs captured. I'll create the thread in the postmortem tracker and link the follow-ups. will post a short summary for #all-hands if we see customer impact.
Maya (SRE): adding this to weekly incident trends as recurrence candidate. frequency: 3 events in last 45 days.
Sam (neteng): permanent routing remediation target: 7 days. will coordinate with infra to roll export filters.
Olivia (eng-runtime): will merge fallback config behind feature flag and schedule a canary tomorrow morning.
Priya (product): thanks all. ping me if comms are needed.
Jin (oncall): closing the triage for now. re-open if retries spike again. :thumbsup:
